title: InuYasha: The Final Act
synopsis:
Thwarted again by Naraku, Inuyasha, Kagome Higurashi, and their friends must continue their hunt for the few remaining Shikon Jewel shards, lest they fully form into a corrupted jewel at the hands of Naraku. But Naraku has plans of his own to acquire them, and will destroy anyone and anything standing in his way—even his own underlings.

The persistent, unyielding danger posed by Naraku forces Sango and Miroku to decide what is most important to them—each other or their duty in battle. Meanwhile, Inuyasha must decide whether his heart lies with Kikyou or Kagome, before fate decides for him. Amid the race to find the shards, Inuyasha and his brother Sesshoumaru must also resolve their feud and cooperate for their final confrontation with Naraku, as it is a battle they must win in order to put a stop to his evil and cruelty once and for all.

episodes.title: Naraku's Heart
episodes.synopsis: Hakudoshi is scheming to take Naraku’s place. He steals Kagome’s Shikon Jewel shards and entices Kagura to betray Naraku.

episodes.title: Kagura's Wind
episodes.synopsis: Upon healing her wounds inflicted by Naraku, using Midoriko’s soul, Kikyo runs into Inuyasha again and reveals the secret to destroying Naraku.

episodes.title: Meido Zangetsuha
episodes.synopsis: It is the day of the annual Fox Demon Promotion Exam. Miroku and his friends get stuck taking the tests. Shippo makes fun of Inuyasha and climbs in rank.

episodes.title: Dragon-Scaled Tetsusaiga
episodes.synopsis: The swordsmith Toshu forged a demon-blade using one of Ryujin’s scales, and the Dakki was born. Every time Inuyasha tries to attack, he is undermined by demonic energy.

episodes.title: The Great Holy Demon Spirit’s Test
episodes.synopsis: The Tetsusaiga has attained the power of the dragon scales. In order to be able to quickly use the demonic power well, Inuyasha has no choice but to go through training.

episodes.title: The End of Moryomaru
episodes.synopsis: Inuyasha and Koga arrive at the scene of Moryomaru and Naraku’s fight. But Moryomaru, who wants his Shikon shards, catches Koga.

episodes.title: The Mausoleum of Mount Azusa
episodes.synopsis: Kikyo has been contaminated by Naraku’s spider web. In order to save her, Inuyasha and Kagome need the bowstring kept in Mount Azusa’s mausoleum.

episodes.title: Among the Twinkling Stars
episodes.synopsis: Kikyo tries to purify Naraku and his Shikon shards. She also tries to purify Midoriko’s will that controls the shards in Koga’s legs.

episodes.title: Sesshomaru in the Underworld
episodes.synopsis: Sesshomaru asks his mother how he can expand Tenseiga’s Meido, the Path to the Underworld. In response, his mother uses the Meido stone that Sesshomaru’s father gave her.

episodes.title: Flowers Drenched in Sadness
episodes.synopsis: The Flower Prince is a demon that feasts on saddened or anguished hearts. Dazzled by the flower’s fragrance, Inuyasha is entangled in a fake dream.

episodes.title: Kanna's Gravestone
episodes.synopsis: The Mirror Demon steals Tetsusaiga’s demonic energy. Inuyasha counterattacks, despite enduring some fierce blows, but all of his attacks aimed at the Mirror Demon end up being taken by Kanna.

episodes.title: Sango's Feelings, Miroku's Resolve
episodes.synopsis: In order to defeat the demons, Sango coats Hiraikotsu with poison. To cleanse it of the poison, the Master of Potions says she must defeat the demon inside the jug.

episodes.title: A Complete Meido
episodes.synopsis: Shishinki, the Ogre of Death, appears before Sesshomaru, telling him that Inuyasha and Sesshomaru’s father stole his Meido Zangetsuha in a battle.

episodes.title: In Pursuit of Naraku
episodes.synopsis: Sesshomaru is enraged when he learns the secret behind Tenseiga. Totosai tries to persuade Sesshomaru that he will surpass his father once he is able to abandon his attachment to the sword as well as his hatred of Inuyasha.

episodes.title: True Heir
episodes.synopsis: Sesshomaru steals Tetsusaiga’s power with Tenseiga, empowered by Kanna’s memento, a fragment of the Mirror Demon. Inuyasha turns into his demon form and tries to attack, but Sesshomaru fires his Meido Zangetsuha.

episodes.title: Hitomiko's Barrier
episodes.synopsis: The priestess Hitomiko lost her life at Naraku’s hands. But she comes back to life and locks Kagome within a barrier. Then, the true spiritual power of Mount Azusa’s bow reveals itself!

episodes.title: Magatsuhi's Evil Will
episodes.synopsis: Inuyasha and Kaede try to find out what is sealing off Kagome’s powers.

episodes.title: The Day of Days
episodes.synopsis: Kohaku remains unconscious after being stared down by Magatsuhi, the evil will. Kagome is worried, but she has to buckle down and study for her entrance exams, so she decides to return home.

episodes.title: Kohaku's Shard
episodes.synopsis: Sesshomaru chases after the evil will, Magatsuhi. But it’s only part of a trap set up by Byakuya of the Dreams. Magatsuhi finds Kohaku lying unconscious, and he tries to deliver his Shikon shard to Naraku.

episodes.title: When the Jewel Is Whole
episodes.synopsis: Naraku is after the last Shikon shard, and he takes Kagome hostage.

episodes.title: Inside Naraku
episodes.synopsis: Kagome graduates from middle school and returns to the feudal era. Shippo and Kohaku stay at Kaede’s village, while the rest of the gang heads out to battle Naraku.

episodes.title: Naraku: The Trap of Darkness
episodes.synopsis: Inuyasha’s heart is devoured by the Shikon Jewel’s poison, and he turns into his demon form. He hurts Kagome, and the darkness in his heart takes control of him.

episodes.title: Naraku: The Trap of Light
episodes.synopsis: Kagome’s spiritual powers are restored, and divine light is revived in Naraku’s Shikon Jewel. However, Naraku uses this as a decoy to lure Sango into his trap.

episodes.title: Naraku's Uncertain Wish[17]
episodes.synopsis: Naraku has been living as a demon despite having a human heart. While fighting him, Kagome asks about his true wish.

episodes.title: Thoughts Fall Short
episodes.synopsis: Naraku heads for the Bone Eater’s Well and vanishes! Before disappearing, Naraku makes his last wish for Kagome, injured at the hands of Byakuya, to be swallowed into Meido, the Path to the Underworld.

episodes.title: Toward Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: When the last person to obtain the Shikon Jewel makes the one correct wish, the jewel will be purified and disappear entirely from this world.
